title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdictional Issue in the Dispute over a Purchase and Sales Contract between the Second Oil Chemical Factory of Chengwu County and the Brick and Tile Factory of Liuzhuang Township, Ruichang County

articles.content_en:
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Issue of Jurisdiction in the Dispute over a Purchase and Sale Contract between Chengyu County No.2 Oil Chemical Plant and Ruichang County Liuzhuang Township Brick and Tile Factory
Fa (Jing) Fu [1985] No. 59
Higher People's Court of Shandong Province:
The Chengyu County People's Court of your province, on November 5, 1985, submitted to our court for designation of jurisdiction a case concerning a dispute over a purchase and sale contract between Chengyu County No.2 Oil Chemical Plant and Jiangxi Province Ruichang County Liuzhuang Township Brick and Tile Factory. Upon contacting the Ruichang County People's Court, it has been determined that the place of signing of the contract in this case is Ruichang County, and the place of performance of the contract is Chengyu County. Pursuant to the provisions of Article 23 and Article 31 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (for Trial Implementation), the people's courts of the place of signing and the place of performance both have jurisdiction over the contract. Since the Ruichang County People's Court, being the court of the place of signing, has already accepted the plaintiff's prosecution, it shall not transfer the case to the Chengyu County People's Court for trial. Now, it is designated that the case shall be under the jurisdiction of the Ruichang County People's Court of Jiangxi Province.
December 14, 1985
